specification: Castle Security & Quality Gate Operationalization Readiness Matrix

components.current_capability: Evaluates 65 atomic controls across 7 domains with IEEE 754 double precision, N/A divisor pruning, and Gate Breaker detection.
components.missing_capability: None for core scoring. Fully deterministic and validated.

components.current_capability: Creates structured packages with SHA-256 checksums, timestamps, source repo, commit SHA, and provenance metadata.
components.missing_capability: Automated ingestion parsers for external test runners (Lighthouse JSON, OWASP ZAP, SSL Labs, CrUX API).

components.current_capability: Resolves and validates C1 to C6 ratified policies across all 16 formal schema fields without template mutation.
Consumes CQS result, evaluates Gate Breakers, score thresholds, UNEXECUTED rules, and issues deterministic release decisions.
components.missing_capability: Direct evaluation of required_controls subset match (presently validated via validator/matrix; runtime subset diffing can be explicitly emitted in blocker details).

components.current_capability: Generates immutable JSON audit record linking Evidence -> Control -> Subcriterion -> Domain -> Score -> Gate Decision.
components.missing_capability: Persistent append-only file export / ledger storage backend.

components.current_capability: In-memory RemediationSession class records multi-cycle history, tracks resolved blockers, and snapshots decisions.
components.missing_capability: Disk persistence (JSON ledger / SQLite), deadline expiration monitoring, and automated transition to BLOCKED on timeout.

components.current_capability: Policy schema defines approval_authority_class and waiver restrictions (C1..C3 allowed, C4..C6 barred, GB never waivable).
components.missing_capability: Formal runtime sign-off artifact generator (e.g. `approval-signature.js`), signature verification, and waiver registration object.
Cryptographic Release Authorization Token / Manifest (`release-certificate.json`) and CI/CD exit-code enforcement runner.

components.current_capability: Policy mandates post_verification_required: true for C3..C6.
components.missing_capability: Post-deployment ingestion workflow that compares staging release snapshot with production 48h telemetry snapshot.

components.current_capability: None (execution currently triggered via programmatic Node.js API / unit tests).
components.missing_capability: CLI entrypoint (`bin/castle-gate.js`), exit code mappings (0 for PASS, 1 for BLOCK, 2 for CONDITIONAL/REMEDIATION), GitHub Actions workflow template.
